cat << 'SCRIPT' > /tmp/list_deletable.sh
#!/bin/bash
RUNNING="grid_b0_3_seed123 rho02_adaptive_tau09_seed42 batch_adaptive_tau_rho06_seed42 bs8_auto_nmin_seed42"
TOTAL=0

for base_dir in /root/provenance_weight_training/output/models /root/autodl-tmp/output/models; do
  for dir in "$base_dir"/*/; do
    name=$(basename "$dir")
    # Skip RUNNING experiments
    skip=0
    for r in $RUNNING; do
      if [ "$name" = "$r" ]; then skip=1; break; fi
    done
    [ $skip -eq 1 ] && continue

    # Get checkpoint dirs sorted by step number
    checkpoints=$(ls -d "$dir"checkpoint-* 2>/dev/null | sort -t- -k2 -n)
    count=$(echo "$checkpoints" | grep -c checkpoint 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
    
    if [ "$count" -gt 1 ]; then
      # Keep last (highest step), delete the rest
      to_delete=$(echo "$checkpoints" | head -n -1)
      for cp in $to_delete; do
        size=$(du -sm "$cp" 2>/dev/null | cut -f1)
        echo "DELETE: $cp (${size}M)"
        TOTAL=$((TOTAL + size))
      done
    fi
  done
done
echo "---"
echo "TOTAL_DELETABLE: ${TOTAL}M"
SCRIPT
bash /tmp/list_deletable.sh

cat << 'SCRIPT' > /tmp/cleanup_checkpoints.sh
#!/bin/bash
RUNNING="grid_b0_3_seed123 rho02_adaptive_tau09_seed42 batch_adaptive_tau_rho06_seed42 bs8_auto_nmin_seed42"
DELETED=0
COUNT=0

for base_dir in /root/provenance_weight_training/output/models /root/autodl-tmp/output/models; do
  for dir in "$base_dir"/*/; do
    name=$(basename "$dir")
    skip=0
    for r in $RUNNING; do
      if [ "$name" = "$r" ]; then skip=1; break; fi
    done
    [ $skip -eq 1 ] && continue

    checkpoints=$(ls -d "$dir"checkpoint-* 2>/dev/null | sort -t- -k2 -n)
    num=$(echo "$checkpoints" | grep -c "checkpoint" 2>/dev/null)
    [ "$num" -le 1 ] 2>/dev/null && continue

    to_delete=$(echo "$checkpoints" | head -n -1)
    for cp in $to_delete; do
      size=$(du -sm "$cp" 2>/dev/null | cut -f1)
      rm -rf "$cp"
      echo "DELETED: $cp (${size}M)"
      DELETED=$((DELETED + size))
      COUNT=$((COUNT + 1))
    done
  done
done
echo "---"
echo "Total deleted: ${COUNT} checkpoints, ${DELETED}M"
SCRIPT
bash /tmp/cleanup_checkpoints.sh
